title: Named Non-Owner Policy Renewal: Offer, Acceptance and Late Payment
content:
## Issuing the renewal
The renewal term of a Named Non-Owner Policy is issued the package's renewal-offer days before expiration of an in-force term not being nonrenewed. The package is kept when the named insured's points do not exceed its renewal points; otherwise the highest lower package whose renewal points are met is offered, and when none is met the term is nonrenewed.

## Accepting the renewal
- A renewal is accepted only on a new Non-Owner Statement signed for the renewal, answering no to owning or leasing a vehicle.
- The statement must be signed no more than the Non-Owner Statement age limit in calendar days before the renewal effective date.
- The renewal down payment required by the renewal billing plan must be posted before the renewal is accepted.
- A renewal is accepted no later than the package's late-renewal window days after the expiration date of the expiring term. Calendar days are counted from the expiration date of the expiring term (the renewal term's effective date) as day 0; acceptance on or before that date plus the late-renewal window days qualifies.

## Late payment
A renewal paid after the expiration date also needs a Statement of No Loss for the lapse and goes in force on the posting date plus the reinstatement effective offset days, with the lapse recorded; a renewal not accepted in the window closes as not taken the day after the window. The expiring term moves to expired on its expiration date.

## Certificates
An SR-22 or FR-44 Operator certificate carries forward to an accepted renewal without a new filing.

## Acceptance timing (abstract, window of W days)
| Acceptance date | Result |
|---|---|
| on or before the expiration date | accepted on time |
| expiration date plus W | accepted with a lapse recorded (boundary included) |
| expiration date plus W plus one | outside the window; the renewal closes as not taken the day after the window |

*Points (hypothetical):* a named insured with 17 points on a package whose renewal points are 16 does not keep that package; the highest lower package whose renewal points are met is offered.
